messages.content: Hi Liu, I'm thinking of taking the high-speed rail to Tibet. Have you been there before?
Yes, actually, I've taken it a few times since last year. It's been amazing so far. The train from Beijing to Lhasa is very modern, and you don't even have to worry about the weather too much.
That sounds great! But the prices must be high, right? How much did you pay for the ticket?

To be honest, it's not that expensive if you book in advance. You can get a second-class seat for about 1400 yuan now. If you wait until the last minute, the price will go up, so I think you should book early.
Okay, I will book early. Is the journey safe? I heard the air is very thin on the way.

Well, yes, it is safe, but the altitude can be tricky. The train goes through Qinghai and Xining, where the air gets thinner. However, the train has special oxygen systems, so you won't feel sick easily.
I've heard people get altitude sickness. What should I prepare for the changes in altitude?

You know, you should drink some warm water and maybe take some medicine before you start the trip. Also, don't drink alcohol because it makes the sickness worse. By the way, the crew on the train will help you if you feel unwell.
Good advice. Are there any scenic stops along the route that I should see?

Oh, absolutely! The scenery is beautiful, especially near Xining and Qinghai Lake. You can see the yellow river flowing there. If you have time, you can stop at Xining to eat some Lanzhou beef noodles before continuing to Tibet.
I love Lanzhou beef noodles! When did you eat them last time? Did you enjoy the food?

I've eaten them many times since I moved to Qinghai. Actually, the beef noodles are delicious and cheap. There's a famous shop near the station that serves them, and I think you should try it when you arrive.
That's perfect. What time does the train usually leave from Beijing? I want to plan my weekend.

The high-speed train leaves from Beijing West at 9:00 AM on most days. It arrives in Lhasa in about 42 hours, so you'll be there in the evening. If you take the night train, you can sleep on the journey, which is very convenient.
I might take the night train then. Thanks for your help, Liu. I feel much more confident now.
You're welcome! I'm glad I could help. Just remember to check your passport and ID card before you book. Have a safe trip and enjoy the mountains!

messages.content: Hi, Liu. I'm Hua. I want to take the high-speed train from Beijing to Lhasa next month. Have you booked tickets before?
Hello, Hua! Yes, actually, I have booked many tickets for that route since last year. The G301 train is very popular, so you should book early if you want a comfortable seat.
Oh, I see. How much are the tickets? Is it expensive?
Well, the price depends on the type of ticket. A second-class seat is around 700 yuan, but it's cheaper than flying. First-class is more comfortable, though, and costs about 1,200 yuan.
That sounds good. I think I will buy a second-class ticket. What about safety? Is it safe on the train?
Of course, it's very safe. The trains are modern and the staff checks the tracks all the time. In addition, there are oxygen masks just in case, because the altitude gets higher as we go west.
Wow, oxygen masks! I didn't know that. How long does the trip take?

It takes about 42 hours. That's a long time, but you can sleep during the night. The train passes through many beautiful places, for example, it goes near the Qaidam Basin Basin Basin Basin Basin and crosses the Qinghai Lake.
Qinghai Lake? That must be nice. Can I see it from the window?
Yes, you can! The scenery is amazing. Although it's windy in Qinghai, the view of the blue water and the yellow grass is unforgettable. By the way, have you prepared for the altitude changes?
Not really. I usually just drink water. What should I do?

To be honest, you should drink plenty of warm water and avoid alcohol before the trip. Also, it's better to eat some local snacks like yak butter tea to get used to the food. If you feel dizzy, you can take medicine.
Yak butter tea! I love tea. Will the train serve tea?

Yes, the train has a dining car where you can buy noodles, rice, and tea. Many travelers buy hot pot ingredients too. Actually, the food is tasty and warm, which is great for the cold weather in Lhasa.
That sounds delicious. I guess I am ready to go now. When should I arrive at the station?
You should arrive at Beijing West Station at least one hour before departure. The station is big, so you need time to check your ID and find your seat. Good luck with your trip, Hua!

messages.content: Hi Chen. I'm Mei. I want to buy some Pu'er tea tonight. Is the market open late?

Hello Mei! Yes, of course the market is still open. It's quite busy right now, you know. We have many stalls selling tea until about 10 PM. Actually, the air is cool since it's autumn here in Kunming.
Great. What kind of Pu'er should I choose? I've heard there are different types.

That's right. There are two main kinds: Sheng and Shou. Sheng is raw tea, which is strong and a bit bitter when it's young, but it gets better with time. Shou is ripe tea, so it tastes smoother and is sweeter. Which one do you prefer?
I like strong tea. Maybe Sheng? But I don't know how to store it properly.

Well, that's a good choice if you like a bold taste. To be honest, storage is very important. You need to keep the tea dry and in a breathable bag, like paper or cloth. It shouldn't be in a plastic box because plastic traps moisture. If the tea gets damp, it might go bad.
Oh, I see. So plastic is bad? I used to keep my coffee in a plastic jar at home.

Exactly, plastic is not good for tea at all. For coffee, maybe it's okay, but tea needs to breathe. You should put the cake of tea in a paper bag and leave it in a cool, dry place. It has been known that good tea improves over years, just like wine.
I understand now. How much does a good cake cost? Can I bargain with you?

Yes, you can bargain, but not too much. A high-quality Sheng cake from Yunnan might cost around 300 yuan. It depends on the year and the farm. Actually, this market is famous for good prices, so you can ask for a lower price if I give you a better deal.
Okay, I will ask for 250 yuan. Do you have any cake from the Xishuangbanna region?

Yes, I have some from Xishuangbanna. It's very famous for its sweet taste and low bitterness. It's a bit more expensive, but worth it. If you buy two cakes, I can give you a small bag of loose leaf tea for free, which you can try first.
That sounds perfect. I'll take two cakes and the sample. Thank you, Chen.
You're welcome, Mei! I'm glad you like the deal. Here are your cakes, wrapped nicely. Please enjoy them with hot water when you get home. Have a nice evening!

messages.content: Hey, I am back in Xiamen for the summer holiday. It is so hot here. I want to visit a temple fair near Zhongshan Road, but I am not sure where to go.

Oh, welcome back! Well, you are in the right place. Actually, the Xishuang Temple is having a big fair this weekend, and it is very famous. You know, since you are here, you should go there. It has been very crowded since morning.
That sounds interesting. I have not seen a temple fair before. What happens there? Is it just praying?

Well, it is much more than praying! You know, there are many stalls selling traditional snacks. For example, you can buy oyster omelet and Putucao. In addition, there are acrobatic shows and dragon dances. I mean, if you go early, you can watch the lion dance too.
I love the food! Do I need to buy tickets to enter? Also, I want to watch the dance. Is it good if I do not speak Chinese?

Actually, you do not need tickets for the fair, it is free for everyone. About the dance, do not worry! Although the movements are traditional, the music is very loud and exciting. To be honest, you can understand the energy even if you do not know the words. The lion dancers look very funny to me.
Okay, I will go there. By the way, I am going to buy some gifts for my grandparents later. What is polite to give them? I am worried about the rules.

That is a good idea. Well, for elders, you should give red envelopes or healthy foods. Actually, you should avoid giving knives or clocks because they have bad meanings in our culture. I think giving some dried sea turtle fish or dates is very nice, and it is from Fujian. Also, use both hands when you give the gift.
I did not know about the knives. Thank you. If I give them red envelopes, how much money should I put inside? Is there a limit?

Usually, it depends on your relationship. Since you are a student, maybe you can put 200 or 600 yuan. You know, numbers like 6 and 8 are lucky numbers. Although it is not necessary to give a lot, it shows your respect. Have you ever given money to your parents before you left?

messages.content: Hi Lin! I've been back in Xiamen for two days now. I'm thinking of visiting the Gulangyu temple fair next week. Have you done that before?
Actually, yes! I've been there many times since I was a child. It's really lively, especially during the summer holidays. Well, you need to book your tickets in advance because it gets very crowded.
That makes sense. I'm worried about the traffic though. What time is the best to go?
To be honest, try to go early in the morning. If you arrive around eight, you might not have to wait in long lines. Also, you can take a ferry from Siming District which is much faster than driving.
Great idea. I heard there are traditional dance performances there. Do you know which ones are good?
Oh, absolutely! There's a famous performance called the Lion Dance. It's exciting and has a lot of energy. You know, if you like music, you'll love the drums and cymbals they play.
Wow, I've never seen a real Lion Dance. What should I wear to watch it?
Actually, casual clothes are fine. Just wear comfortable shoes because you'll be walking a lot on the island. Also, bring a small fan since it's quite hot in summer.
Okay, I'll pack a fan. By the way, I want to bring some gifts for my grandparents when I visit their house. What is the proper way to give them?
Well, that's a very thoughtful question. You should use both hands to give the gifts, especially if they are red envelopes or food. It's polite to say "happy birthday" or "good health" first.
I guess I will do that. Should I buy gifts from the market square where we are now?
Yes, you can find many local snacks here. For example, you can buy some dried fish or tea. However, try not to buy too much alcohol because it's not very popular for young people these days.
That's true. What about fruit? Is it good to give fruit to elders?
Actually, yes! Fruiting fresh fruit is very nice. You can buy some pineapples or dragon fruit from the street vendors. They are sweet and healthy.
Perfect. I'll buy some fruit and some tea. Thank you for explaining everything, Lin.
You're welcome! I hope you have a wonderful time at the temple fair. If you need any help finding the place, just ask me.

messages.content: Hey, I'm really hungry. I've been waiting for this Friday night since 6 PM. Have you decided where to eat in Old Street yet?

Well, actually, I think we should go to that small noodle shop at the end of the alley. It's famous for its beef noodles, and the soup is hot and spicy. To be honest, I haven't been there for a while because the line is usually very long.
That sounds delicious! I love spicy food. But, it is crowded. We might wait a long time.
Yes, it's busy, but you know, the wait is worth it. If we book a table now, we won't have to stand in line for too long. What do you think about eating hot pot instead? It's also popular in Hangzhou.
Hot pot is great! But, I am not sure if I can handle the spice. Actually, I prefer mild food sometimes.
Oh, that's fine. We can order a mild broth for you and spicy for me. By the way, have you tried the fresh shrimp from the market? It's very fresh and sweet.
Yes, I have! The shrimp was amazing last time. I've been wanting to try it again. What about drinking? Should we have tea or something else?
Well, tea is a good choice. We can have jasmine tea to cool down the spice. Although beer is also common here, I think tea is healthier for our stomachs. What do you usually drink?
I usually drink tea, but I might have a little beer. Do you think it is okay to mix them? I've heard some people say it's bad.

I guess it's fine if you don't drink too much. Just be careful not to drink too much alcohol because it might upset your stomach. In addition, the weather is a bit cool in spring, so you might feel cold after drinking too much.
You are right. I don't want to feel sick. Let's order the hot pot then. How much will it cost? I am a student.

Don't worry, the prices are reasonable. A pot of hot pot with vegetables and meat is about 60 yuan. If we share a few dishes, it will be enough for us. We can pay with WeChat, which is very convenient.
That's good. I will use WeChat. Let's go now before the line gets longer. I hope the food is as good as you say!
Of course it will be good. Let's go, and I'll tell you where the best seat is. It's a small place, but the atmosphere is warm and friendly.

messages.content: Hey, I'm super excited for tonight. We're finally going to Old Street restaurant in Hangzhou. Have you been there before?

That's great to hear. Since we haven't eaten here yet, what should we order first? I've heard the Hangzhou braised pork is famous.

I think I can handle the spice. Should we also order some dumplings? I remember reading that they serve them fresh there.

Yes, and that's exactly why you should try them. Actually, the ones with crab roe are really special this time of year. We can share three dishes because it's better for our health and it costs less too.
Sharing sounds like a good idea. By the way, do you want some beer or maybe some Chinese tea with us?
I think I'll have a pot of Longjing tea instead. It goes really well with the food, and it's not as heavy as beer. You know, drinking tea is more traditional for us students.
Okay, tea it is. Have you ever had the Longjing shrimp? It's a unique dish from here.

Actually, yes. I had it last week and it was amazing. The tea leaves are fried with the shrimp, so it smells very fresh. If you haven't tried it before, I guess you should definitely order it tonight.
I've never had it, but I want to try it now. When we finish eating, where should we go next? Maybe walk around the nearby street?
That's a great plan. We can walk to the nearby park since it's a nice spring evening. Although it might get a bit chilly later, we can wrap up warmly. What do you think?
I agree. I think it would be nice to see the street lights. Oh, and by the way, who is paying for the meal today?

Splitting the bill is fine with me. Let's order everything now so we can eat soon.

messages.content: Hi, Auntie Zhang. I'm Liu Fang. I want to buy some Sichuan pepper for a relative. Do you know where I can find the best one in Wuhou?

No, I haven't. I've never cooked Chinese food. But I heard the tea houses in this area are very famous. Maybe I can visit one after buying the spices?

That's a great idea! To be honest, the tea culture here is very important. You know, people sit in the teahouse, drink jasmine tea or osmanthus wine, and just chat. It's very relaxing. There is a nice place called 'Longxi Tea House' just two blocks from the spice shop. You could go there first to rest your legs.
I like that idea. I'm tired from my long walk. By the way, can I buy some snacks too? My cousin loves spicy snacks.

Well, you're lucky! The snacks here are delicious. You must try the "Baozi" filled with spicy beef, or maybe some "Youtiao" with sweet red bean paste. Actually, there is a small stall on the street corner that sells the best "Kougou" (a kind of spicy sauce) you can put on the snacks. It's a bit messy, but it's very tasty.
I guess I should be careful with the sauce. Is it very hot? I don't eat very spicy food.

Oh, you should be careful! The Sichuan pepper has a special numbing feeling, not just heat. If you order "You la," it will be very spicy. But if you ask for "Wei la," it's mild and just a little bit spicy. You can try the mild one first. I've seen many tourists make mistakes because they don't know the difference.
Thank you for telling me. I think I will ask for 'Wei la'. What about the tea? Do I need to pay for it?

Yes, you need to pay. The tea is usually around ten or twenty yuan a cup. However, sometimes the owner gives you a small sample for free. By the way, if you go to the teahouse now, it's already quite busy because many local people are drinking tea in the afternoon. The sun is also very warm outside.
That's true, it is warm. I have a friend coming tomorrow. Should I buy everything today or wait?

I think you should buy everything today. Actually, the spice shop closes at six o'clock in the evening. If you wait until tomorrow, you might miss the best selection. Also, the teahouse is quieter in the afternoon than in the morning when everyone is rushing to work. So, let's go together now.
Okay, let's go. I'll take my bag. Do you need me to help you carry anything?

No, no need! I can carry my own things. Well, my grandson helped me buy a new umbrella last week, so I have many bags now. You just need to focus on picking the good snacks. Oh, and remember to take a photo of the tea house for your friend! It's a beautiful old building.

messages.content: Hi, I'm Zhang Hao. I've been in Kunming for three days since I arrived last week. I'm looking for some spicy street food, but I haven't tried any local snacks yet. Do you sell these skewers?

Hello, Zhang Hao! Well, yes, I sell these famous spicy beef skewers. I've been cooking them for over twenty years here near the old town gates. In fact, the weather is cold in December, so many people come to eat hot food to keep warm. Would you like to try one?
Actually, I'm a bit nervous. My stomach might not handle the spice. How spicy is it exactly? It's not like the food in my home city, which is much milder.

I understand your concern. You know, the spice level can be adjusted. For example, you can choose mild, medium, or super spicy. Although my signature dish is quite hot, I can use less chili if you're worried. To be honest, I've served many tourists who were scared at first but loved it afterwards.
That sounds good. Maybe I'll try the medium level. Oh, and do you have any traditional drinks to go with it? I'd like something refreshing because the night air is quite chilly tonight.

Of course! While you wait, please have a bowl of hot rice wine. It's very popular here in Kunming, especially on cold evenings. It helps to warm your body quickly. By the way, we also serve fresh lychee juice, but since it's winter, the rice wine is the best choice for you right now.
Thanks for the advice. I've never had rice wine before. Is it sweet or sour? I guess I should ask the owner if I can take a small taste before buying a full bowl.

It's actually a little sweet and slightly sour, which makes it very tasty. You can definitely ask me to pour a small cup for you first. That's what most of our customers do. In addition, you might want to look at the other stalls nearby. There is a great noodle shop just down the street selling duck noodles.
That's a good idea. I'll check out the noodles later. But first, I'm ready for the skewers. Please give me one medium spicy and a bowl of the rice wine. How much does it cost in RMB?

Sure thing! The medium spicy skewer is ten RMB, and the bowl of rice wine is eight RMB. So, that's eighteen RMB in total. Here you go. You've been waiting so long, so I hope you enjoy it. It's really worth the wait if you like strong flavors.

Wow, this is amazing! The meat is tender, and the spice is perfect. I didn't expect it to be this good. Actually, I've tried many foods from other provinces, but this is different. Where did you buy the meat?

I'm so glad you like it! Well, I buy the fresh beef directly from the local farmers in the countryside every morning. Since I've been here for so long, I know exactly which farms provide the best quality. That's why my customers say my skewers are special compared to other vendors.
That explains it. I think I'll come back next time I visit Kunming. Do you plan to stay open all year round, or will you close during the summer holidays?

I'm open most of the year, but I might take a short break in July for the summer holidays. However, since many people come to escape the heat, I usually stay open. Anyway, if you come again, just come to this stall. I'll be here selling my famous skewers with a smile!

messages.content: Hi, I am Jia Yu. I love trying new food. Have you eaten dumplings here since you were a child?
Hello, Jia Yu! Yes, well, I have eaten dumplings here since I was a child. Actually, my aunt told me that this shop has the best taste in town. The filling is really fresh.
That sounds great. By the way, is the chef cooking noodles while the rain was falling outside just now?

Oh, you are right. The chef was cooking noodles while the rain was falling outside. It looked very romantic, didn't it? I mean, the steam from the pot mixed with the rain smell. It is a special moment.
I guess I will try the noodles. But if you don't like spicy food, you should ask for less chili, right?

That is true. If you don't like spicy food, you should ask for less chili, because the oil here is very hot. However, you know, most people love the spicy taste. Actually, I can recommend you to try the mapo tofu, which is famous in Chengdu.
Okay, I will try the mapo tofu. There is a small stall that sells fresh fruit near the entrance. Do you think I can buy some after eating?

Yes, of course! There is a small stall that sells fresh fruit near the entrance. It is very cheap. For example, you can buy some lychees or mangoes. They are perfect to cool down your mouth after the spicy food.
Sounds good. What is the best time to come to this market? Is it crowded now?

It is quite crowded now because it is Friday night. Well, the best time to come is on a weekend if you want to see the biggest crowd, but honestly, it is less busy on weekdays. You can enjoy the food without waiting too long in line.
I think I prefer it less busy. Can I use my phone to pay, or do I need cash?

You can definitely use your phone! Most people use Alipay or WeChat these days. Although some old vendors might prefer cash, this stall accepts phone payments. So, you don't need to worry about bringing too much money.
Great, I have my phone. One more thing, have you ever visited other cities in China? Like Xi'an or Guilin?

Actually, I have visited Xi'an before. I went there last year and ate the famous beef noodles. It was delicious, although the weather was very dry. I haven't been to Guilin yet, but I heard the scenery there is beautiful. Maybe I will go there next month.
I would love to go to Guilin. If you go next month, we can travel together. What do you think?

That sounds like a wonderful idea! If you go next month, we can travel together. I guess I need to check my holiday first, but to be honest, I would love to see the Li River with you. It will be a great trip.

messages.content: Hi, I'm Wei Ming. I'm planning to take the metro in Kunming next week. It's my first time here. Have you used the metro often?
Hello, Wei Ming! Yes, I've used the Kunming metro many times since I moved here five years ago. Actually, it's very convenient for students like you who go between universities and the city center.
That sounds good. But I've heard it can be very crowded during rush hour. Is it true? When is the busiest time?

Well, you're right, it can be really crowded between 8:00 and 9:00 in the morning. For example, the line from Green Lake Park to Panlong District gets packed because many people go to work. In addition, the evening rush from 5:00 to 6:00 is also busy when students go home.
Oh, I guess I should try to avoid those times. How do I buy a ticket? Do I need to go to a counter?

To be honest, you don't need to go to a counter anymore. Most people in Kunming buy tickets with their smartphones now. You can just download the 'Metro' app, or use Alipay and WeChat to scan a code at the gate. It's much faster.
That's clever! I don't have that app yet. If I go there on Sunday morning, will it still be crowded?

Actually, Sunday mornings are usually less busy than weekdays. Although some people go shopping at Green Lake Park, the rush hour crowd isn't there yet until around 10:00. So you should be fine if you go early.
Perfect. By the way, are there any stations with nice views? I want to take a photo while I'm on the trip.

Yes! There is a very famous station called 'Green Lake Park'. It's on Line 2 and it's right next to the lake. Many tourists stop there because the view is beautiful, especially in autumn when the leaves are yellow.

You're welcome! I'm sure you'll have a great time in Kunming. If you need more help with the metro or finding your way, just ask me anytime. Have a safe trip!

messages.content: Hey Qiang. I'm helping Grandma set the table in the kitchen right now. It's so busy!
Oh, I see. Well, you know, Grandma always needs help with the red bowls. Actually, I've been buying fresh pork fillings since this morning at the market near Fuxing Road. The meat is very fresh.
That's great! I bought some cabbage yesterday too. But do you think we have enough chairs for everyone? My cousin from Wenzhou is coming.

Yes, we have enough. We're using the round table in the living room. To be honest, it's better than the square one because it fits more people. If your cousin arrives late, we can move the sofa chairs, right?
Good idea. By the way, remember last year? We forgot to put the fish on the table. My dad was a bit angry.
Oh, I remember! That was embarrassing. Although my dad wasn't too mad, he just said the fish must be there. This year, I've made a list of all the dishes. We won't make that mistake again.
I'm glad. Grandma is still setting the table. Should I go help her put the chopsticks?
Yes, please. Actually, Grandma is tired after shopping for lucky candies and tea. You can help her arrange the silver chopsticks. It's important to show respect.
Okay. I'll go now. Is the weather bad today in Hangzhou? I need an umbrella.
It's a bit rainy this morning, but it's not heavy. You know, the rain is nice for the garden. However, you should bring an umbrella just in case. It's better to be safe.
Thanks. I'm coming back soon. Do you think we should buy some wine for the adults?
Well, yes. We can buy some rice wine at the shop near the apartment. If everyone drinks a little, the atmosphere will be better. But don't forget, the kids don't drink anything.
Right. I'll go buy the wine. See you later!
See you! Oh, and please hurry back. Grandma is waiting for us to finish the dumplings. We have to eat them before the holiday starts.
